src: unique longest multicolor run; shorter monochrome bars
path: long-run pixels cast four diagonal rays in left/top order, stopping at earlier painted rays; short bars flood through still-bg cells by diagonal adjacency
trajectory: paint each visited pixel with the source pixel or bar color
transform: preserve input foreground and fill only the diagonal ray paths and diagonal-connected regions
multi_step: draw occluding rays from the longest run first, then fill each short bar's remaining diagonal-connected region
